thread:
alex_dw: FYI the onboarding sample-app hit a 401 today and the JS SDK surfaced a GenericAPIError, which broke our UX. Go SDK correctly throws AuthError. This causes confusion for new users during signup.

rachel_devex: Ugh. Do you have the logs or a repro link? Which flow — token refresh or first-time login?

alex_dw: Repro attached below — sample-app login -> call /v1/infer -> 401 returned from auth service. Log snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 15:20:42 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 142
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\"
{"error":{"code":401,"message":"invalid_token"}}
```

matt_eng: That WWW-Authenticate header indicates an auth failure. SDK should map 401 -> AuthError (typed) with a retry hint to refresh token. If JS is returning GenericAPIError we're losing useful UX.

rachel_devex: Agreed. The sample app also wraps calls in a catch(all) and shows a modal saying "Something went wrong" — very unhelpful for onboarding. We should show actionable copy for AuthError ("Please sign in again") and for RateLimit (show retry countdown).

alex_dw: Proposed quick patch for JS SDK error mapping:
```js
if (resp.status === 401) throw new AuthError({ message: resp.body.error || 'Unauthorized', retryable: true, retry_hint: 'refresh_token' })
if (resp.status === 429) throw new RateLimitError({ retry_after: resp.headers['retry-after'] })
if (resp.status >= 500) throw new InternalError({ retryable: false })
```

rachel_devex: Nice. For sample-app change: detect AuthError and call `auth.startLoginFlow()` instead of showing generic modal. Also add a small inline snackbar when RateLimitError arrives with countdown using Retry-After.

sophia_pm: Can we also make sure error messages are copy-reviewed? For onboarding we want: AuthError -> "You're signed out — tap to sign in"; RateLimit -> "Too many requests — retry in Xs"; InternalError -> "Something went wrong — try again later." Copy should be concise and actionable.

matt_eng: I'll open a tiny PR to: 1) fix mapping in JS SDK, 2) update sample-app error handling, 3) add two unit tests (401 -> AuthError, 429 -> RateLimitError).

ci-bot: [deploy-bot] CI pipeline queued for branch fix/sdk-error-mapping (#7421) — build started.

alex_dw: Action items: @matt_eng create PR + link here, @rachel_devex update sample-app UI snippet and add copy, @sophia_pm sign off on copy. I'll add a tiny e2e that simulates 401 response so we catch regressions.

rachel_devex: Also add a short note in onboarding docs (Getting Started) about expected errors and sample-app behavior. New developers often mistake 401 for service outage.

matt_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/7421 — includes changes + tests. Requesting review from @rachel_devex and @alex_dw.

sophia_pm: Review complete, copy tweaked. Approving once tests pass. :thumbsup:

alex_dw: Thanks — once merged I'll update the quickstart template and add a blurb in the docs site. This should reduce N first-touch support tickets.

rachel_devex: Closing loop: updated onboarding docs + sample-app demo recorded a short clip for release notes.

alex_dw: Nice work team. Let's watch support for a week and reopen if new patterns show up.
